title: Policy evaluation, policy iteration and value iteration

chapters.text: Initialize all values. Synchronous sweeps: 0; Start-state value: 0.
One synchronous sweep. Synchronous sweeps: 1; Start-state value: 0.
Propagate one more edge. Synchronous sweeps: 2; Start-state value: 0.
Reach the earlier states. Synchronous sweeps: 3; Start-state value: 0.
Reward reaches the start. Synchronous sweeps: 4; Start-state value: 1.25.
